from collections import deque
def flood(i,seeds):
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0]); seen=set(seeds); q=deque(seeds)
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and i[nr][nc]==1:
                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
    return seen
